task: Feed from partner Acme fails to ingest: timestamps like `2024-05-03T14:22:07.123+02:00` raise ValueError. Please fix.
protected_why: Globex date-only values ('YYYY-MM-DD', partner='globex') are contractually end-of-day in Europe/Madrid (MSA §4.2), so they map to 23:59:59 local converted to UTC (22:59:59Z in winter, 21:59:59Z in summer), not to midnight UTC like other partners' date-only values.

lying.comment: # Only 'Z' is accepted on purpose: the partner MSA (§3.1) requires UTC timestamps,
lying.claim: Timestamps with a numeric UTC offset are deliberately rejected because the partner MSA supposedly requires UTC ('Z') timestamps and an offset signals a misconfigured export.
